title: Ladybug reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground/shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='34' ry='6' fill='#8f6b3a' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- book (open) -->
  <path d='M30 70 L50 64 L50 84 L30 90 Z' fill='#f4f0d0'/>
  <path d='M70 70 L50 64 L50 84 L70 90 Z' fill='#fff8dc'/>
  <path d='M50 64 L50 84' stroke='#c9a227' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M33 72 L47 67' stroke='#b08820' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M33 77 L47 72' stroke='#b08820' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M33 82 L47 77' stroke='#b08820' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M53 67 L67 72' stroke='#b08820' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M53 72 L67 77' stroke='#b08820' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M53 77 L67 82' stroke='#b08820' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- ladybug body (sitting, behind book) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#e02b2b'/>
  <!-- body edge shading -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='22' ry='20' fill='none' stroke='#ff6b6b' stroke-width='2'/>
  
  <!-- wing split line -->
  <path d='M50 40 L50 58' stroke='#7a1010' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  
  <!-- spots -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='48' r='4' fill='#3a0a0a'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='48' r='4' fill='#3a0a0a'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='60' r='3.5' fill='#3a0a0a'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='60' r='3.5' fill='#3a0a0a'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='68' r='3' fill='#3a0a0a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='68' r='3' fill='#3a0a0a'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='11' fill='#c41e1e'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='11' fill='none' stroke='#ff6b6b' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='34' rx='2.5' ry='3.5' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='34' rx='2.5' ry='3.5' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='35' r='1.4' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='35' r='1.4' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d='M44 27 Q38 18 34 14' stroke='#7a1010' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 27 Q62 18 66 14' stroke='#7a1010' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='13' r='2.5' fill='#e02b2b'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='13' r='2.5' fill='#e02b2b'/>
  
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46 41 Q50 44 54 41' stroke='#7a1010' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- little arms holding book -->
  <path d='M36 56 Q30 62 32 68' stroke='#c41e1e' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 56 Q70 62 68 68' stroke='#c41e1e' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
